name: Turkey
dek: Ankara Bölge, WMO 17130. The capital, inland. Not the coast.
paragraphs: The reference station is Ankara Bölge, WMO 17130, height 891 m. It is inland and high, so the coasts are warmer in winter. The Turkish submission has many station files; none were averaged. Istanbul has its own sheet.

The highest average high in the table is 31.0 °C, in July and August. The lowest average low is -2.2 °C, in January. The wettest month by the precipitation column is May, at 50.98 mm, and the driest is August, at 13.99 mm. No official tourism-office tipping guidance was found for Turkey on this pass, so the sheet has no tipping line.

climate.caption: Reference station: Ankara Bölge, WMO 17130. Inland; not the coast and not a national average.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed; a value printed with no leading zero, such as -.3, is shown as -0.3.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type C and F, 220 V, 50 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Turkey at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read. The IEC line prints 220 V for Turkey, and that is the figure shown.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: Article 46 of the Highway Traffic Law No. 2918, in the text on the official Mevzuat legislation portal, says traffic on highways flows on the right, and that unless a sign says otherwise drivers keep to the right of the road in their direction of travel, or on multi-lane roads to the lane their speed requires.
driving.sourceTitle: Karayolları Trafik Kanunu No. 2918, Madde 46, mevzuat.gov.tr

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Turkey, last reviewed August 25, 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Turkish Lira and the code TRY under the country name Türkiye.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab and zone1970.tab each give Türkiye one row, Europe/Istanbul. There is no second zone for the country in either file.

entry.label: Official entry requirements
entry.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Türkiye
entry.note: The foreign ministry's visa information for foreigners. We do not restate a visa rule.
